name: oru
description: Oru: your team's shared brain for business, brand and design. Connects Oru's MCP server, keeps Oru in the lead on every task, bridges Figma and your connected Drive, Microsoft 365 and Slack, keeps your company file server in a project (Oru Connect), and saves your agent conversations.

oru_url.title: Oru address
oru_url.description: Leave as is. Change it only to point at another Oru server, such as a local one (http://localhost:8787). It is the address that serves /mcp, /context and /agent-sessions.

save_conversations.title: Save conversations
save_conversations.description: Save this agent's conversations (your messages and its replies, without tool output or secrets) to your private chat in Oru, so Oru learns from them. Turn off to stop.

api_token.title: Oru access key
api_token.description: Optional. Leave empty: once you sign in (claude mcp login plugin:oru:orubrand, or /mcp > plugin:oru:orubrand > Authenticate), Oru links this machine and its hooks get their own key. Set one here only to use a key you made in Oru > Connect your agent.
